changelog: Small fixes from walking the install as a stranger. Setup always prints the sign-in link, so a browser that did not open is no longer a dead end. Running the install command with no terminal now says so instead of doing nothing silently, and --help shows help instead of starting setup. The server no longer writes message text to its log.
features: Setup prints the sign-in link while it waits, for when no browser opened
No terminal and not signed in: one line says to run npx slashvibe-mcp setup
npx slashvibe-mcp help | --version; an unknown command on a terminal shows the commands instead of running setup
trust and untrust take exactly one handle
The server no longer logs message text; start-up diagnostics only with VIBE_DEBUG
After install, the first words are: what's waiting on /vibe
